why: the ordinary case, already in its stored form
surrounding whitespace, which a paste often carries
runs of spaces collapse, so alignment while typing costs nothing
tabs are whitespace too, and a terminal completion inserts them
backslash continuations join, because the hints wrap commands that way
a bare newline joins as well, which is what pasting a wrapped line gives
a real recorded command with a pipe, quotes and a continuation
